subject.title: [Bug]: exec tool silently corrupts 2>&1 / 2>/dev/null shell redirect arguments

question: Should #87980 stay open until there is exact current-main proof for the `2>&1` whitespace merge, or should maintainers treat the adjacent parser/pass-through evidence as enough to close it?
rationale: Source inspection shows the current command path should preserve shell text, but the exact reported corruption was not reproduced and no merged PR clearly claims this issue.

options.title: Keep Open For Exact Proof
options.body: Leave the issue open and ask for or add a targeted current-main regression covering `open 2>&1` and `--json title,state 2>&1`.

options.title: Close As Adjacent Fix
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the existing `2>/dev/null` parser coverage and command-string pass-through as sufficient proof for this report.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Exact Proof
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and ask for or add a targeted current-main regression covering `open 2>&1` and `--json title,state 2>&1`.
